title: Orchestrator state-machine tests use the subsumed random-sequence runner; Hypothesis stays optional
summary: tests/test_orchestrator_state_machine.py runs seeded random operation sequences with delta-debugging shrinking on every test run (default 6 seeds x 30 ops, ~26 s; AGENT_OS_SM_SEEDS/OPS to scale), plus a planted-violation test and a shrinker test. The Hypothesis machine runs automatically only where the dev-only package is installed (.agent-local/venv-dev was used for the comparison); no dependency is added to pyproject. Chaos kill-point: the restart operation drops in-flight workers.

prior_art.found: Hypothesis RuleBasedStateMachine is the reference design; mutmut for mutation strength
prior_art.reused: rule/invariant structure and the shrinking idea (delta debugging) from Hypothesis; Hypothesis itself as an optional driver
prior_art.why_custom: at equal budget the subsumed runner found the planted bug with a 5-op minimal sequence and needs no dependency (EXP-0003); operator prefers subsuming
